design contract Battery backpack V2 rev B ('sits down'), printable frame and cap, both Orange. The 2S 3000 mAh pack (74 x 34 x 20 envelope) stands upright, leads up, 6.3 mm right of centre in a column of the frame; the lower tier ends at z -46 so the seated robot keeps 10 mm or more under the backpack; nothing grows behind today's x -75.55, above z 43 or wider than |y| 32.05. The 16 mm LED button sits in the cap's upper left beside the pack; the Pololu 2813 is taped to the left wing's outer wall, the DFR1202 to the battery column's left rib on the left wing, the XIAO SAMD21 high on the right wing wall with its USB-C behind a window in the cap. Two fixed L contact pads lie flush under the floor at y +-9; the cap is a back plate over both tiers, held by two M2 x 8 (high) into frame bosses and two M2 x 6 (low) into columns in the wings beside the battery column; two cap pins locate the pad tabs. The boards, the battery, the diode and the pads go in from the open back after the frame is on the robot, and nothing fixed stands in their paths. The frame screws onto the OpenRB pack posts with the four M2 x 6 as today.
